recommendation: Keep the empty audit commit. No core follow-up is needed unless ChargeItem returns to core; if it does, preserve the external artifact's CodeableReference service definition with MedicationRequest and ServiceRequest targets.
issue_request: The Published/Persuasive with Modification issue requested that ChargeItem.service support pay-in-advance workflows by allowing MedicationRequest and ServiceRequest, with the final resolution also changing the element type to CodeableReference.
initial_application: Commit 10e9603435c0b0a8fd7ac0f00356a0592051ecec applied the issue by changing source/chargeitem/structuredefinition-ChargeItem.xml so ChargeItem.service used CodeableReference and included MedicationRequest and ServiceRequest target profiles. The same targets and type were still present immediately before ChargeItem was removed from core.
additional_context: The PA 2021-10-13 minutes corroborate the 4-0-0 disposition and CodeableReference scope, and the originating Zulip thread confirms the pay-in-advance use case. In November 2025, current-core source removed ChargeItem and ChargeItemDefinition from source/fhir.ini and source/chargeitem; current ballot/module text points to the HL7 Administrative Incubator instead. The current Administrative Incubator ChargeItem JSON still has ChargeItem.service as CodeableReference with MedicationRequest and ServiceRequest targets.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The requested R5 core change was applied and retained until the resource left the core build, and there is no current authoritative ChargeItem.service source location in this checkout that needs correction.
